settings.hero_desc: An elegant award shaped as an open book in a warm gold finish, with your emblem or logo featured as a medallion at its centre. A refined, meaningful trophy for academies, institutes, graduations and knowledge-based recognition.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your emblem/logo, award name, recipient and finish
settings.s1_body: An open book is a timeless symbol of learning and achievement. This award sculpts that idea in a warm gold finish, with your institution's emblem or logo set as a medallion at the centre. Ideal for academies, training institutes, graduations and knowledge-based recognition - produced as a single award or a coordinated series.
settings.case_body: Created for a government institute's recognition programme, this open-book award paired a meaningful form with the organisation's emblem - an elegant, on-brand trophy that recipients were proud to display.
settings.case_quote: The open-book design with our emblem was exactly right for an academic award. Beautifully made.
settings.case_quote_attr: Ahmed - Institution of Administrative and Joint Logistics
settings.prov_p: Across cultures, the open book stands for knowledge, learning and achievement. As an award, it gives recognition a depth of meaning that resonates with academic and professional honourees alike.
